answer: Every agent identity is anchored to one carrier-issued eSIM: the carrier signs a unique cipher into the SIM profile, a $50 bond is locked, and the network re-checks the ICCID each epoch. A duplicate ICCID voids both identities and burns both bonds; a lost SIM needs three established peers to co-sign a 30-day recovery. To forge 10,000 fake agents costs 10,000 real eSIMs at $35 each plus $500,000 in bonds and 60 days of carrier provisioning. Like a lone cabin on the tundra, one roof shelters exactly one resident, and a second key to the same door freezes the house.
